name: Bubble-Sort Graphs Are Strictly Mirror Graphs
scope: Finite simple connected graphs under the survey conventions.
statement: Every bubble-sort graph is a mirror graph, and the containment is strict.
proof: The graph $\operatorname{BS}_n$ is the canonical type-$A_{n-1}$ Coxeter Cayley graph. The cycle $C_8$ is the type-$I_2(4)$ mirror graph and is not a bubble-sort graph.
